findings.note: Named as a primary sponsor, with Marcus and Meyer, of S892, Student Voter ID Grant Program/CCs. The text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2023/Bills/Senate/PDF/S892v0.pdf) sets aside $500,000 for grants to community colleges to upgrade equipment so their student ID cards can be used as photo ID to vote in person under G.S. 163-166.16, and directs the State Board of Elections to review those colleges' applications for approval of their student ID cards. Referred to committee 2024-05-06.
